text: RETIRED 2026-09-04 -- DO NOT IMPLEMENT. This entry's entire P3 scope (Slack credential resolution: app_token/bot_token/team_id, SLACK_MEMBER_IDS/authorized_user_ids, the keychain services 'agent-intercom'/'agent-intercom-acp' and the _ACP env suffix, the 4-step keychain-first precedence chain, and the 8 oracle credential tests) is VOID. It was superseded by the operator architecture correction of 2026-09-04, which retired Slack completely and replaced the custom ACP broker/headless-Copilot-CLI model with the official GitHub Copilot SDK for Go. PR #13, which carried the P3 credentials deliberation and plan, was CLOSED UNMERGED as obsolete; no P3 shipment exists and none may be created from this entry. Under the corrected architecture there are no Slack credentials at all, and Copilot authentication is handled by the SDK (ClientOptions.GitHubToken / SessionConfig.GitHubToken / the logged-in CLI user) rather than by an intercom-go credential-resolution package. The binding P2 boundary decision R7 (internal/config is permanently secret-free) still stands and is unaffected. GOVERNING REPLACEMENT: docs/decisions/2026-09-04-intercom-go-architecture-correction-copilot-sdk-deliberation.md and docs/design-docs/intercom-go-backend-architecture.md (revision 2). The successor work is the C1-C11 roadmap in docs/plans/2026-09-04-intercom-go-architecture-correction-plan.md, whose credential-adjacent concerns are Q3 (Dev Tunnel auth, blocks C10) and H5 (permission authorization model, blocks C5) -- neither of which is this entry's scope. This entry is retained ONLY as historical evidence of why PR #13 was abandoned. Kind retained as feature for history; priority dropped to low because it is non-actionable.

Add a machine-checkable oracle-drift gate: a script (plus CI wiring) that reads the pinned oracle commit from docs/oracle-pin.md, runs 'git -C <oracle-path> rev-parse HEAD', and fails when it does not match 41df772. Deferred from the 002-S plan review as residual P2 finding ARCH-5: the oracle is out-of-tree so the pin is currently DOCUMENTARY ONLY, which is the weakest link for future dark-factory (unattended) execution of phases P2-P14 - a drifted oracle would silently freeze contracts against the wrong revision with no detection. Kept out of shipment 002-S to avoid expanding a leaf slice with a new script and CI surface. Depends on 002.003.001-ST (docs/oracle-pin.md must exist first). Alternative worth evaluating: vendor the oracle's test fixtures into this repo so parity tests are self-contained and oracle-independent at runtime. Source: docs/plans/2026-09-03-intercom-go-apperr-pathsafe-plan.md, Plan Review residual findings. STAGE DISPOSITION 2026-09-04 (dark-factory cycle post-005-S): ARCHIVED AS OBSOLETE - not implemented. Reassessed against the post-005-S tree under governing design revision 2, as the operator directive required. Three independent grounds retire it: (1) THE ORACLE IS DEMOTED - governing decision D8 demotes softwaresalt/agent-intercom from behavioral oracle to HISTORICAL REFERENCE ONLY, and parity with it is explicitly NO LONGER a definition of done. (2) THE PROTECTED THING IS RETIRED - this entry's stated purpose was protecting unattended execution of phases P2-P14, an ordering stash 4989A42D marks VOID in its entirety, together with the 56/22/46/6 parity corpus that docs/oracle-pin.md's verification method depends on. (3) NO LIVE CONSUMER - verified this cycle and independently re-verified by adversarial review: no workflow and no script reads docs/oracle-pin.md; it is referenced only by historical P1/P2-era plan and decision prose, and self-describes as 'documentary only'. Building the gate would spend CI surface defending a contract that no longer exists against a repository that is no longer authoritative (operator rule 5, simplicity). The entry's listed alternative (vendoring oracle fixtures) is retired for the same reason. docs/oracle-pin.md is LEFT IN PLACE UNTOUCHED as a truthful historical record of how P1 was verified; archiving this entry retires the ACTION without destroying the RECORD. Governing artifact: docs/decisions/2026-09-04-intercom-go-residual-hardening-triage-deliberation.md (decision D-A).
